pole_run: A person sprints forward carrying a long pole in both hands, held low in front of them.
pole_vault: A person sprints with a long pole, plants the pole tip into the ground, swings up and over a high bar, and falls onto a mat.
pole_fall: A person plants a long pole too early, the pole stands up, and they fall backwards onto the ground.
pole_land: A person drops onto a thick mat on their back after jumping over a bar, then lies still.
